name: Self-order mobile product detail screen
describe: Product detail: "Back" underlined link, full-width image, p-6 gap-4 body with h1 (text-xl semibold), muted description, price (text-lg medium), Variants and Add-ons option rows, 36px round quantity steppers and a rounded-full "Add to cart" button.

Opened when a menu card is tapped and product_detail_enabled is set. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
